text: In cases involving nervous shock, special rules exist to restrict the number of potential claims.
Critically assess the extent to which you agree with this statement. [25]
With reference to decided case law, critically analyse the operation of the defence of volenti non fit
injuria (consent) in relation to trespass to the person. [25]
The aim of the compensation award in tort is expressed in the maxim restitutio in integrum
(restitution in full).
Critically examine the extent to which this aim is achieved. [25]
Section B
Pierre drives to work and stops at a shop in order to buy some food. As he is in a hurry he leaves
the key in the ignition and runs inside. While he is in the shop someone gets into his car and drives
off at speed. The car is then involved in a collision in which Yves is knocked down whilst using a
pedestrian crossing. The person who took the car runs from the scene and cannot be traced.
Yves is taken to the emergency department of the local hospital, where he is examined by Henri,
a junior doctor. Henri tells Yves that he is suffering from bruising and sends him home with
medication for his pain. Yves’ pain gets worse and he returns to the hospital the following day
where another doctor diagnoses a serious neck injury.
Advise Yves as to the liability in negligence of Pierre, Henri and the hospital. [25]
Adam buys two cars with which to operate a taxi business from his home. He hires a number of
drivers to operate the taxis which are collected from Adam’s home and returned late at night. This
causes some disturbance to Adam’s neighbour Frank as he is frequently awoken by noise when
the cars are returned.
Adam also stores fuel for the cars in his garden shed. Frank complains to Adam about the strong
smell of the fuel and the fact that it has leaked into his garden, killing his vegetables and flowers.
Advise Frank as to the likely success of any actions brought against Adam and the remedies
which might be granted by the court. [25]
Anil owns and runs a small hotel. During a storm a number of roof tiles fall, causing injury to
Pravin, a guest at the hotel.
Anil hires David, a roofing contractor, to carry out repairs. When the work is finished, Anil looks at
the roof and the job appears to have been well done. However David had used the wrong type of
nails to secure the tiles.
A month later, tiles fall from the roof repaired by David. Nadia, a member of the hotel staff, is
injured and her car is also damaged.
Assess Anil’s liability as the occupier of the hotel to Pravin and Nadia. [25]
